fields.description:
Rebuild the Deals related lists on Account using Dynamic Related List – Single. Deal has two lookups to Account, so there are two distinct lists and they must be named apart.

=== FIELDS ===

* Child relationships renamed on Deal — Deals Partner and Deals Operator. Kobi live: 'I'm going to rename one of the child relationships a deal partner and then the other one to deals operator.'

* On Operator, columns: Deal Name / Partner / Country / State-Province / Vertical / CPA / Exclude from Partner Bonuses / Deal Status / Effective Start

* On Partner, columns: Deal Name / Operator / Country / State-Province / Vertical / CPA / Exclude from Partner Bonuses / Deal Status / Effective Start

* Sort: Effective Start Date — Kobi: 'you can sort it by effective start date. That's a good one.'

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* Remove the Deal Version column entirely. Kobi, Aug 17: 'there's no deal version. So that entire column can be removed from the deals like when you add the deal fields.' Deal Version was scrapped on Aug 11 — Taryn's doc still lists it in both OP-9 and PT-10.

* Remove the New action button — these lists are display-only.

* Use Dynamic Related List – Single, not the layout-driven Related Lists component. Kobi: 'the related lists generally pull from the page layout configuration but we try to move away from that... What you actually want to use is a dynamic related list single.' Reason: per-list column control.

* Why there are two lists — worth writing down because it caused visible confusion: Kobi 'the reason why we have two deals is because the deal can be related to a partner and an operator. Both of them are accounts. So there's two relationships.' This is the mechanical expression of Deal being the junction between Operator and Partner.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===

* Column shows Exclude from Partner Bonuses (BUILD-153). 'Counts Toward Bonus' from the mockup is NOT built — decided 2026-08-17: 'We will do Exclude from Partner Bonuses as agreed upon.' One field, not two. Taryn's OP-9 and PT-10 stories both list Counts Toward Bonus; ignore it.

=== NOTES ===

* PARTIALLY BUILT. Rebuilt live on Operator during the Aug 17 call. Taryn's own outstanding item: 'deals we just did earlier that I'll clean up' — column cleanup and the Partner-side list remain.

* Build on the Dynamic Lightning record page using Dynamic Forms, not the classic page layout.

* Combined OP-9 and PT-10 — identical structure, one sitting.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc OP-9 + PT-10

* Aug 11 call — Deal Version scrapped

* Aug 17 call — rebuilt live, relationships renamed, sort + column decisions

Dependencies: Deal object (exists)

Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.

comments.body: Partially built, per this ticket's own notes: the Operator-side related list was rebuilt live on Aug 17, but column cleanup and the Partner-side list are still outstanding. Full spec calls for two Dynamic Related List – Single components on Deal (via renamed child relationships Deals Partner and Deals Operator), columns Deal Name / Partner or Operator / Country / State-Province / Vertical / CPA / Exclude from Partner Bonuses / Deal Status / Effective Start, sorted by Effective Start Date, no New action button, Deal Version column removed.
